subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “If you want to help, write your name on the list at the front desk.”?
options: It needs to be clear, honest, and followed by better care next time.
Freedom works better when it considers the people who must share the room.
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.
It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「If you want to help, write your name on the list at the front desk. A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care…」，答案為「A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.」。
